name: jtao
description: Local engineering Harness for Coding Agents: persistent FTS5 memory, WorkItem DAG with real verification receipts, and detached background Solo/Team orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Local memory, WorkItem DAG, and background Solo/Team runner
interface.longDescription: Bundles jtao's local SQLite WAL/FTS5 memory recall hooks, 18 MCP tools (memory, workflow DAG, real verification receipts, and non-blocking background Solo/Team scheduler), plus explicit-only workflow skills ($jtao-work, $jtao-solo, $jtao-team) and memory skill ($jtao-memory).
defaultPrompt: Use $jtao-work to break this requirement into a verified WorkItem plan
Use $jtao-solo to run the active WorkItem unattended in the background
Use $jtao-team to split and run this feature concurrently with file ownership checks
